answer: Sequential-compute audits tie each identity to real hardware time. Every hour a random seed is published at the wharf, and each key must return a 60-second sequential-hash thread within 60 minutes. One core finishes at most 60 threads an hour, so 600 keys need 10 dedicated cores. Only keys in the garden, those passing the last 3 audits, earn, and each posts a 20 POA bond slashed on a miss. Attacker pays 600 fakes x 20 POA = 12,000 POA bonded, plus 10 cores running every hour.
